uheqf_levels.name: O-Level (UCE)
uheqf_levels.description: Ordinary Level Certificate. A prerequisite for A-Level and some diploma programs.
uheqf_levels.requirements: At least 5 passes at the same sitting

uheqf_levels.name: A-Level (UACE)
uheqf_levels.description: Advanced Level Certificate. Standard entry for Bachelor's degrees.
uheqf_levels.requirements: 2 Principal Passes OR 1 Principal + 2 Subsidiary Passes in relevant subjects

uheqf_levels.name: Higher Education Certificate (HEC)
uheqf_levels.description: One-year bridging program for students who don't meet direct entry requirements.
uheqf_levels.requirements: 1 Principal Pass OR 2 Subsidiary Passes at A-Level

uheqf_levels.name: Diploma
uheqf_levels.description: Practical focused qualification with 70-75% practical content.

uheqf_levels.name: Bachelor's Degree
uheqf_levels.requirements: Entry via Direct (A-Level), Diploma Holders, or HEC routes

uheqf_levels.name: Master's Degree
uheqf_levels.description: Postgraduate qualification offered as Plan A (Coursework & Dissertation) or Plan B (Coursework & Project).

uheqf_levels.name: PhD
uheqf_levels.description: Doctor of Philosophy, highest academic qualification.
